Maria (Marketing): Quick favor — final copy pass on the product announcement + benchmark blurb and webinar CTA. Can someone review by EOD? Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xExampleLink
Ethan (Growth): On it. I'll check subject lines and seed segments.
Zoe (Designer): Can we confirm hero image specs? Need 1200x628 and a 1:1 variant for socials.
Liam (Product): Heads up — benchmark claim '2.5x throughput' needs a source. Linking perf run: https://internal.redwood/perf/rv2-2026-02-08
Natalie (Legal): I can greenlight the wording if we swap 'guaranteed' -> 'typical' and avoid absolute time claims.
Maria (Marketing): Updated snippet below — please quick pass.
```
Hero headline: Ship LLM inference that's predictable and lean.
Benchmark line: Typical throughput improvements observed vs baseline: ~2.5x (internal perf run 2026-02-08).
CTA: Register for the launch webinar — seats limited.
```
Ethan (Growth): For seed emails — two subject options: "See how we cut inference costs by 50%" and "Behind the scenes: predictable LLM inference". Also thinking split A/B on the benchmark vs product value angle.
Zoe (Designer): Also need a CTA button label. I vote "Reserve your seat". Will mock variants with primary (teal) and tertiary (outline).
Liam (Product): Inbound routing: map registrants to HubSpot list "webinar-launch-3267", set lead source = "launch-blog-seed-email", and tag "perf-interest". Nurture workflow id: 1122.
Maria (Marketing): UTM plan: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=3267_launch, utm_content=seedA. Will append campaign params to doc links.
Ethan (Growth): I'll run a 500-person seed to PLG segment A and 200 to partner leads. Will include tracking pixel and prefill for known fields.
Natalie (Legal): Approve the updated benchmark phrasing. No PII or compliance flags for the seed send as described.
marketing-bot: Reminder scheduled: approval follow-up at 16:00 PST (3267890400).
Maria (Marketing): Thanks — merging edits into the doc now and scheduling the email for Wed AM. :party-parrot: 
Ethan (Growth): 👍 prepping the send and will confirm HubSpot mappings once the doc is merged.
Zoe (Designer): Dropping hero + 1:1 social crops into the doc by EOD.
Liam (Product): I'll add the perf link as a footnote in the blog and include the test run ID.
Maria (Marketing): Great — closing thread for now. If anything blocks, DM me.
